Notes: Release 1.3.9: Busy lamps follow the PBX. Green is idle, solid red is in use, flashing red is ringing, and grey means the phone is offline. Busy and Do not disturb send BusyHere and keep sending it. Call quality is shown only after audio is measured. The keypad adds voicemail, group pickup, park, intercom, forward, and redial, using the PBX feature codes. Dial, Video, and Voicemail sit on one row. Installing an update keeps the saved licence, extension, server, and contacts.
